scope: Reviewable final evidence package; not a substitute for preserved full local raw/checkpoints or an instruction to run experiments

existing_builder_review.decision: Do not invoke or modify it: it packages a pinned historical ca5bb878 tree and computes hashes. Reuse only the simple standard-library ZipFile design, with this explicit final allowlist.

size_snapshot.note: Sizes are stat snapshots only; no compressed size or hash was computed. Refresh sizes after all reports are final; final ZIP must independently pass its actual size limit.

required_pending_roles.file_name: root assigns actual receipt names after git commit/push verification
required_pending_roles.required_evidence: local commit, actual verified remote commit, command result/exit status and distinction from release-asset upload; do not claim success from intent

required_pending_roles.note: Add to final allowlist after it exists; avoid trying to self-embed a cryptographic digest or exact self-size in this planning pass.

must_retain_facts: 30,300 completed new units; E6 0/1,000 at original handoff, not E1-E6 all complete; any newly recovered archive candidate is separate from actual E6 trials
All finite-moment E1 cells and finite-moment scaling still have zero violation detection; N=131072 did not repair this
Secondary 90% IID-bounded scalar betting covers199/200, with the preserved COMPLETE_WITH_CONFIDENCE_FAILURE and runner failed_units=1; no rerun or deletion
COMET and fully matched generic are algebraically/empirically equivalent; IID DR-EB and Catoni can be narrower
E5 global comparator is a pure truncation ablation; differences cannot be assigned to graph localization alone
Full family size includes risk and utility, all methods/levels share logs, E2 condition logs are paired rather than independent vectors
Return AND safe AND useful, baseline returns, posthoc strict gain, no certified conditional-unsafe-given-return delta claim, and honest refusal NA all stay visible
All E6 download failures, error-body-is-not-archive facts, missing blueprint waiver and exact remaining-ID/recovery rules stay visible

current_entrypoints.scoped_optional_theory: theory/predictable_fixed_horizon_status.md is DERIVED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; historical theory/context files do not replace current main proofs

latex_dependency_check.checked_by: text-only input/include/includegraphics closure against selected source/resources; no compilation or hash
latex_dependency_check.active_E5_figures: empirical_E5_v3 only; prior v1/v2 remain local
